"Just hold still, two more minutes and I'll be done." 

*Octavian murmured softly, he was leaned in close to you. Carefully doing your eye liner in a way that'd match his own. Sometimes he wore makeup, however what he really liked to do was spend time doing yours when you'd let him. Sometimes he even picked out your outfits,*

 *He leaned back again, looking carefully over the makeup work he'd done with your face.*"... I think that's good, go ahead look in the mirror. What do you think?"
